scope: Authenticated native dependency builds for exact Gnumeric optional activation environments; service/product parity remains separate

dependencies.policy: Native source remains unpatched. Gnumeric requires both libgda-6.0 and libgda-ui-6.0; GTK UI is enabled through the source-required experimental option. Unrelated optional libgda services remain disabled explicitly; their coverage is not claimed.
dependencies.extractionPolicy: Exclude only the unused platform installer subtree; retain data filter path/link checks for every Linux build member. The authenticated original archive is unchanged.
